note: Headwords written with kanji where the vocabulary lists a verb in kana, because the sentences write it with kanji (行きます) and a form built from a kana headword would not match them. Keyed by word id (the vocabulary record's id); applied by scripts/generate-pack-ja.mjs. Labels do not change. classes: the conjugation class of a word the source lists without one (授業を受ける is an expression), so the screens can build its forms; the class is only used where the record has none.
